biggest_catch: Account must stay in good standing for 90 calendar days and the bonus does not post until ~100 days after opening (within 10 days after the 90-day mark). The $400 also requires an ongoing recurring electronic deposit (payroll/government benefits) plus online banking and e-statement enrollment.
catches: Bonus offer expires 11/30/26; account must be opened by that date.
To qualify: open a new FirstLink Gold Checking account, set up a recurring electronic deposit (such as payroll or government benefits), and enroll in online banking and electronic statements.
Account must be in good standing for 90 calendar days; if requirements are met, the $400 bonus is deposited to the new account within 10 days after the 90 days.
One bonus per household. Limited to new money not currently held at First US Bank.
Employees of First US Bank are ineligible.
Minimum deposit required to open an account is $100.

$7.50 monthly maintenance fee: $4.50 waived if the balance does not fall below $500 any day of the statement cycle; $3.00 waived with electronic statements (so $0 fee with both e-statements and a $500+ balance). Fees could reduce earnings.
Official page does not state a 1099/tax-reporting disclosure; the bonus is taxable income under standard IRS treatment of bank bonuses.

FirstLink Gold's 2.27% APY tier requires meeting monthly qualifications (e-statements + 9 debit transactions + one direct deposit/ACH debit, or $50k+ in CDs, or $20k+ in loans); otherwise the balance earns 0.05% APY.
